get.summary: Current subscription (free default when no row) + the tier table the portal renders.
get.description:
GET / — current subscription (free default when no row) + the
 tier table the portal renders.

post.summary: POST /checkout {tier} — create a Plugipay hosted checkout session for a paid tier; the browser redirects to data.hostedUrl.
post.description:
POST /checkout {tier} — create a Plugipay hosted checkout session
 for a paid tier; the browser redirects to data.hostedUrl. The
 subscription itself is only written when the
 plugipay.checkout_session.completed.v1 webhook lands.

get.summary: No auth, returns service name + status + dependency checks.
get.description:
GET /api/v1/health — no auth, returns service name + status +
 dependency checks. Every Forjio service exposes the same shape
 so uptime monitors are uniform.

get.summary: Host → accountId — used by the frontend middleware to route a custom domain's request to the right workspace.
get.description:
Host → accountId — used by the frontend middleware to route a custom
domain's request to the right workspace. Returns null for Suppuo hosts /
unknown domains.

get.summary: Public branding (logo + colors + name) for the help center AND the hosted portal's pre-auth screen.
get.description:
GET /public/help/:accountId/branding — public branding (logo + colors +
name) for the help center AND the hosted portal's pre-auth screen.

get.summary: Serve the uploaded brand logo bytes.
get.description: GET /public/help/:accountId/logo — serve the uploaded brand logo bytes.

get.summary: Tokenized status view — public messages only, no internal notes.
get.description: Tokenized status view — public messages only, no internal notes.

get.summary: Pre-ticket config for the embeddable widget + hosted form (the branding footer renders before any ticket exists).
get.description:
Pre-ticket config for the embeddable widget + hosted form (the
 branding footer renders before any ticket exists). No secrets.

post.summary: Agent-created ticket (logging an inquiry that arrived out-of-band, e.g.
post.description:
Agent-created ticket (logging an inquiry that arrived out-of-band,
 e.g. WhatsApp). The requester still gets the status-link email.

get.summary: Distinct tags across the workspace's tickets — autocomplete feed.
get.description:
Distinct tags across the workspace's tickets — autocomplete feed.
 (Must be mounted before /:id so 'tags' isn't read as a ticket id.)

post.summary: POST — message events (JSON; raw bytes captured by the app-level parser's verify hook for signature checks).
post.description:
POST — message events (JSON; raw bytes captured by the app-level
parser's verify hook for signature checks).
